## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sahetukaduka* is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna* in the Abhidhamma Piṭaka of the Pali Canon. In modern analysis, it is translated as "The Dyad 'accompanied by root, and unaccompanied by root'" and constitutes the second dyad chapter in the origination of dyads (*duka-paṭṭhāna*), which encompasses one hundred dyadic chapters [Nyanatiloka 1938].

**Sources**

- [Nyanatiloka 1938] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Piṭaka (1938, repr. 2007) — English translation of the dyad title and its placement within the Duka-Paṭṭhāna.
